Maya (Product): Heads-up: Acme pilot kickoff tomorrow. Need a short cross-team checklist to lock scope. Customer asks: private VPC, customer-managed HSM keys, 200 qps sustained, p95 <150ms on 1k-1.5k token tails. Proposal: 2-week pilot with a 72h soak. Can teams confirm owners and top 3 risks?

Ravi (Runtime): Owners: Ravi = perf tuning/canary, Tina = infra provisioning, Priya = security/KMS, Noah = runbook/alerting, Liam = CS contact. Risks from runtime: seq tail causing batch variability, KV cache pressure. Need concrete token distribution to size batch windows.

Tina (Infra): We can provision a dedicated staging pool (6 x A100) but will need a reservation cut by EOD today. Also HSM connector: two modes — proxy to customer's HSM or use our managed HSM with customer keys. Which mode?

Priya (Security): Customer insists on HSM in their VPC. That means we must deploy our connector into their network and run the ATO. Timeline: ~15 business days for connector + legal. Short path: reuse our existing KMS proxy (if Acme signs the connector PO). Need their SOC2 point-of-contact.

Noah (SRE): Runbook items: prewarm strategy, Canary traffic pattern, automated fallback to smaller model, and alert thresholds. Proposed SLOs: p99 < 400ms, p95 < 150ms target, error rate < 0.1%. If we breach p95 twice in 30m, auto-failover to fallback-model. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

Liam (CS): Will collect SOC contact today. Acme will accept fallback if it'll be documented and they can opt-out. Acceptance checklist they gave: HSM in VPC, 48h 200 qps soak with p95 <150ms, signed runbook.

Ravi (Runtime): Quick config suggestion for staging canary we can try: ```yaml
candidate_model: acme-prod-v2
canary_ratio: 0.1
batch_window_ms: 10
max_tokens_estimate: 1500
prewarm_pools: 2
fallback: acme-efficient-v1
```
Please confirm avg_tokens_per_call and percentiles.

Maya (Product): Avg tokens ~400, median 512, 95th ~1100, occasional 1500. I'll drop a CSV with sample distribution into the ticket.

Tina (Infra): Reservation time: 3 business days to spin staging infra after sign-off. HSM network deployment requires customer's VPC peering or private endpoint; need network CIDR and acceptance to run connector.

Priya (Security): I'll start the ATO pre-check now. Action: Maya to share Acme SOC contact and legal PO. I'll compile required attestation docs.

Noah (SRE): I'll draft the runbook and the Slack alert playbook. Action: Ravi to provide exact latency curves from local perf runs; I'll put in threshold hooks.

Ravi (Runtime): I'll run perf with tails and post results in thread by EOD. Quick note: to meet p95 <150ms at 200 qps we probably need 7 shards of A100 or a mixed AVX+GPU packing depending on batch window. Will confirm.

Maya (Product): Owners & next steps recap: Maya -> customer liaison + distro CSV; Ravi -> perf numbers + canary config; Tina -> infra reservation + network ask; Priya -> ATO + legal sync; Noah -> runbook + alert hooks; Liam -> acceptance coordinator. Please paste 2-3 task bullets here so I can publish the checklist.

Ravi (Runtime): Tasks: 1) run perf suite with 1k/1.5k tails, 2) validate batch_window 8-12ms, 3) prepare fallback model and sizing doc.

Tina (Infra): Tasks: 1) reserve 6x A100 staging pool, 2) prepare VPC connector deployment template, 3) list required network CIDRs and firewall rules.

Priya (Security): Tasks: 1) start ATO intake, 2) request SOC docs from Acme, 3) draft key rotation/usage policy for customer HSM.

Noah (SRE): Tasks: 1) draft runbook with canary/rollback play, 2) create Prometheus alerts for p95/p99 and error rate, 3) simulate failover to fallback model in staging.

Liam (CS): Tasks: 1) collect SOC contact + PO, 2) confirm acceptance window flexibility, 3) coordinate demos during soak.

deploy-bot: deploy log: queued staging pool creation job #4921. ETA 4h.

Maya (Product): Thanks — I'll compile and add to the pilot inbox. If any blocker emerges call out here; otherwise let's sign-off by EOD and I will nudge legal for expedited connector terms. :rocket:
